text:
Lina (PM): Heads-up 1: web4re planning rollout guidance for tenant-aware routing + soft-degrade (customers asked for opt-in and controlled exits). Need a compact playbook: canary cadence, A/B checks, flag patterns, exact rollback gates, and customer comms. Brainstorm here?

Rafi (SWE): Short sketch: staged slices by tenant count (not users). Start tiny: 0.5% tenants (smoke), then 2%, 10%, 50%, then full. Hold times: smoke 15m, 2% 1h, 10% 6h, 50% 24h.

Tor (SRE): Ops constraints: have per-region throttles and an immediate route-back kill switch. Suggested hard gates: auto-pause and rollback if any of these for 10 minutes: p95 latency > baseline * 1.15 OR 5xx rate > baseline + 0.004 (0.4% absolute) OR sustained GPU util > 88%. Also ensure each request has a rollout tag for tracing.

Priya (ProdOps): Flag naming proposal: `rollout.routing.tenant.{tenant_id}.mode = {off|mirror|canary|active}`. Mirror mode = shadowing only (no client-visible change). Also add an admin-global `rollout.routing.override = {on|off|drain}`. Documented TTL for flags and audit events required.

Rafi (SWE): A/B parity plan: mirror 1% of requests for 30m -> compute BLEU-like similarity score on core prompts and a cheap embedding-dist metric. Stop if embedding divergence > 1.5% or BLEU-style regression > 1%. We'll run the parity check at each expansion boundary.

Jing (CSE): Customer-facing commitments: 48h opt-in notice, immediate opt-out via portal (will revert flag for tenant), and a follow-up report within 48h of any incident. Enterprise customers can request scheduled windows.

Tor (SRE): Alerts & dashboards: create composite alert that triggers when (p95 > baseline*1.15) OR (error_rate > baseline + 0.004) OR (cost_per_token > baseline*1.12). Split alerts by region and by canary slice. Dashboards: canary vs baseline latency, per-tenant error spikes, parity-sample diffs.

Rafi (SWE): Pseudo-run:

```
# pseudo-runtime check
mode = flags.get_mode(tenant)
if mode in ["canary","active"]:
  tag_request("routing_rollout_v1", tenant)
  if mode == "canary":
    shadow_request_to_new_path()
  else:
    route_to_new_path()
else:
  route_to_legacy()
```

Priya (ProdOps): Rollback taxonomy: soft-stop (pause expansion, keep slice running), revert (flip tenant flag to off), and emergency evacuate (route whole region to legacy). Define owners: SRE executes technical rollback; ProdOps coordinates, PM approves for customer-impacting reversions. CSE notifies customers.

Lina (PM): Numeric gates proposal to agree on: p95 warning at +7% (notify), hard hold at +15% (pause and review). 5xx hard threshold +0.4% absolute. Parity regression threshold 1.5%. Cost-per-request > +12% hard hold. Any hit triggers an automated pause plus manual ops review.

Tor (SRE): Also add a soft-warning tier: p95 +5% for 5m => slack alert to oncall but no auto-pause. Helps catch trends.

Jing (CSE): For customers who opt in, include an "escape hatch" link in the portal that requests immediate opt-out; ops will confirm and revert within 15 minutes SLA. We should log opt-out times to the tenant audit trail.

Rafi (SWE): Metrics hooks required: per-tenant p95, 5xx counts, model-output-parity score, cost-per-request. We'll add sampling for full-text diffs for failed parity samples.

Priya (ProdOps): Preflight checklist (quick): 1) baseline metrics recorded for last 48h, 2) smoke QA pass (n=100 prompts), 3) capacity headroom confirmed per-region, 4) alert runbook ready, 5) customer comms template drafted.

Lina (PM): Agreed. Action items: Priya to draft runbook template and flag naming doc (today), Rafi to add parity metrics & tagging (tomorrow), Tor to create composite alerts + kill-switch (tomorrow), Jing to draft customer opt-in/out copy (EOD).

ops-bot: scheduled_job: rollout-scan started for slice=0.5% -> check ETA 15m

Lina (PM): Thanks all. Please drop the runbook link here when ready and web4ll lock the signoffs. :white_check_mark:
